summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing the acquisition of Belly River light oil assets from Highwood Asset Management Ltd. for $105M in cash ($96M net of adjustments), implying ~$38,400/boe/d and 3.2x NOI at $80 WTI 2026. The deal consolidates the company's position as the largest Belly River producer, adding ~2,500 boe/d (76% oil) and 35 net sections. No advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. Closing is expected on June 30, 2026, funded from existing cash/credit. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration of the 2027 six-well development program.
